text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A and Stock E at a profit felt rewarding, but I should sell only when it fits my plan and view of the stock—not simply to lock in a gain.","I sold Stock B and Stock D at large losses, which was painful. I should review a losing position objectively and act on its prospects rather than cling to my purchase price or avoid admitting a mistake.","I traded infrequently while account value moved both up and down. I can avoid reacting to ordinary swings, but should still check my holdings periodically and make deliberate decisions."]}
